name: ippo_p_supplementary_s1_matched_arm
registration: internal, author-controlled, hash-locked; not externally registered
role: post-confirmation supplementary analysis; never merged into the frozen confirmatory test ippo_prior_confirmation_v1
question: Does the IPPO-P benefit come from the pressure logit prior itself, or merely from the additional halting-count pressure information channel?

method_new.name: IPPO-State
method_new.definition: IPPO with the clipped within-intersection z-scored per-phase pressure vector (identical computation to the IPPO-P prior, floor 1.0, clip [-3,3]) concatenated to the actor observation, with prior_mode='none' (no logit prior). Actor otherwise identical to IPPO.
method_new.rationale: isolates the state channel of the IPPO-P treatment package

design.primary_metric: U (demand_service_time over 5 eval seeds, lower is better)
design.pairing: paired against the already-archived IPPO results from ippo_prior_confirmation_v1 on the same seeds (identical protocol)

decision_rule_primary: per-seed paired sign of mean U (IPPO-State minus IPPO): positive seed count reported; exact two-sided paired sign test on 10 seeds

state_channel_advantage.condition: IPPO-State better in >= 8/10 seeds (sign test p < 0.05 direction favouring IPPO-State)
state_channel_advantage.conclusion_writing: report that the benefit is attributable to the additional halting-count state rather than the logit-prior integration; weaken the main claim: the evaluated treatment is the full package and the state channel dominates; IPPO-P retains no advantage over the simpler state formulation

prior_advantage.conclusion_writing: report that the logit-prior integration outperforms supplying the same pressure vector as state, strengthening the training-consistency claim; state that the comparison is within the same harness and is a post-confirmation analysis

indeterminate.conclusion_writing: report as indeterminate at n=10; the logit-prior versus state-channel distinction remains structurally different but not empirically separated; main-claim wording unchanged from the current structural-only statement
indeterminate.further_experiments: none; no additional seeds; report and stop

anti_goals: no post-hoc reinterpretation after seeing results
no additional seeds or scenarios added to rescue any branch
results never merged into or re-labelled as the confirmatory test
no selective reporting: the branch outcome is reported regardless of direction
